title: Edinburgh Waverley to Inverness — Full Journey Timetable for Sleep

announcements.text: This is the nine-thirty departure from Edinburgh Waverley to Inverness, calling at Stirling, Perth, Pitlochry, Aviemore, and Inverness. This train is formed of four carriages.
We are now approaching Stirling. Stirling Castle can be seen on the hill to your right. We will be calling at Stirling in approximately two minutes.
We are now at Stirling. We will be departing Stirling in approximately two minutes.
We are now approaching Perth. We will be calling at Perth in approximately two minutes.
We are now at Perth. We will be departing Perth in approximately two minutes.
We are now entering the Highlands. The scenery from here to Inverness is considered some of the most beautiful in the United Kingdom.
We are now approaching Pitlochry. We will be calling at Pitlochry in approximately two minutes.
We are now at Pitlochry. We will be departing in approximately two minutes.
We are now approaching Aviemore. Aviemore is a popular resort town in the Cairngorms National Park. We will be calling at Aviemore in approximately two minutes.
We are now at Aviemore. We will be departing in approximately two minutes.
We are now approaching Inverness. We will be arriving at Inverness in approximately two minutes. Alighting passengers, please ensure you have all your belongings with you.
We are now at Inverness. This is the end of the service. Thank you for travelling with ScotRail. We hope you have a pleasant stay in the Highlands.
